svg.title: Incident workflow - stages 1 to 4 (regression introduced by a deployment)
svg.text: Incident workflow - regression introduced by a deployment (stages 1-4)
Review mode: acts only with approval
a new application version is rolled
out through the standard deploy path
the change carries a latent defect
polls Log Analytics (Logs Query API) -> features -> model
writes score, anomaly flag and top metric back via
Logs Ingestion API -> DCE -> score DCR -> Log Analytics
approved command run on the VM
Log Analytics: KQL over metrics, scores, logs
Activity Log + Resource Graph: change history
from host + top metric to the process whose
own logs show the degradation, then its
fix plan, validation plan - the record
(if Actions is unavailable) - same deploy path
status script to check version, metrics, scores
same install/restart path as the original release,
stable, score below threshold, alert resolved
Fix PR -> review -> merge to main
CI deploy workflow runs on merge to main
issue closed by the SRE Agent after verification
triggered by label approved; implements the fix
plan from the issue, adds a regression test,
opens a PR referencing the issue
human (or agent) adds label approved to the issue
= approval boundary; later reviews and merges
5 Horizontal deployment: identify affected hosts, roll out the reviewed fix, verify recovery
6 Postmortem and standardization: record the incident and update operating practices
Arrows are numbered in time order; 7 and 11 are the human approval boundaries (Review mode, label approved).
Every command on the VM is an infrastructure write and requires Review-mode approval; the Stop hook only checks the agent's final response after execution.
